# Mobile: code-host connections and the bot repository picker

## What to build

Bring the code-host integration to the Expo app. Two screens change:

1. A new **Connections** settings screen.
   - It lists the user's GitHub and GitLab connections and disconnects them through a native destructive context menu or alert.
   - Token connect (GitHub or GitLab) uses native text fields: Server URL and a secure Token field.
   - GitLab OAuth opens the authorize URL with `expo-web-browser` `openAuthSessionAsync`, which returns to `rakazo://code-hosts/gitlab/callback`. The app then calls `codeHosts.gitlab.oauth.complete({ state, code })`.
2. A **Repositories** group in the bot settings screen.
   - Bound repositories appear as rows, removed through a native swipe or context menu.
   - Repositories are added through the existing native `MenuPicker` or a pushed list screen for long lists.
   - When the deployment has no computer (`me.sandboxProvider` is `"none"` or `""`), the group shows only "This bot needs a computer to use repositories."

Follow AGENTS.md: use native iOS controls (`@expo/ui`, native header items, context menus, alerts, pickers) wherever possible, and keep copy minimal. The visible strings are: "Connections", "GitHub", "GitLab", "Server URL", "Token", "Client ID", "Client secret", "Use OAuth app", "Connect", "Disconnect", "Repositories", "Add repository" (accessible name), and "This bot needs a computer to use repositories."

Already in the codebase (all in `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`). Mobile calls these as slash paths with `rpc("codeHosts/connections/list")` and so on.

- Connections: `codeHosts/connections/list` returns `[{ id, provider, baseUrl, authKind, label, createdAt }]`. `codeHosts/connections/remove` takes `{ connectionId }`.
- Token connect: `codeHosts/github/connectToken` and `codeHosts/gitlab/connectToken` take `{ baseUrl, token }`. On a scope problem they fail with error data `{ error: "missing_scopes" | "excess_scopes", missing? | excess? }`.
- GitLab OAuth:
  - `codeHosts/gitlab/oauth/start` takes `{ baseUrl, clientId, clientSecret, client: "mobile" }` and returns `{ authorizeUrl }`.
  - The API callback redirects mobile sessions to `rakazo://code-hosts/gitlab/callback?code&state`.
  - `codeHosts/gitlab/oauth/complete` takes `{ state, code }`.
- Repositories:
  - `codeHosts/repositories/list` takes `{ connectionId, query? }`.
  - `bots/repositories/list` takes `{ botId }`.
  - `bots/repositories/set` takes `{ botId, repositories: [{ connectionId, hostRepoId }] }`.
- `BOT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS.advanced` in `packages/contracts/src/bot-settings-layout.ts` already contains `"repositories"` after `"skills"`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/mobile/app/(settings)/account.tsx` (lines 729–740): the settings list (`{ title: t("Integrations"), href: "/integrations" }`, …). Add `{ title: t("Connections"), href: "/connections" }` next to Messaging.
- `apps/mobile/app/(settings)/_layout.tsx`: register `<Stack.Screen name="connections" options={glassHeaderOptions(t("Connections"))} />`.
- `apps/mobile/app/(settings)/messaging.tsx`: a small settings screen with a connect action and a list. It shows `rpc("messaging/installations/start")` followed by `Linking.openURL`.
- `apps/mobile/lib/sso.ts` (lines 61–67) and `apps/mobile/lib/billing.ts` (lines 59–67): `expo-web-browser` `openAuthSessionAsync` via **dynamic import**, so older binaries still work, plus validation of the callback URL's protocol. Mirror this, falling back to `Linking.openURL`.
- `apps/mobile/app.json`: `scheme: "rakazo"`.
- `apps/mobile/app/bot-settings.tsx`:
  - line 158: `rpc("bots/get")`;
  - lines 568–606: Advanced section and `MenuPicker` usage;
  - lines 950–1003: local `SettingsGroup`/`SettingsSectionHeading`.
- `apps/mobile/components/menu-picker.tsx`: `MenuPicker`/`MenuPickerMenu` (`@expo/ui/community/menu`). `onPress` pushes a list screen for long lists, like `app/bot-model.tsx`.
- `apps/mobile/components/bot-member-picker.tsx`: an example of picking several items.
- `apps/mobile/lib/api.ts` (line 841): `rpc(proc, body, options)`.
- `apps/mobile/lib/query.ts`: `rpcQuery` for TanStack, if the screen uses queries.
- `apps/mobile/lib/appearance` and `apps/mobile/lib/native`: tokens and PlatformColor. Never hardcode colors.
- Tests:
  - `apps/mobile/lib/bot-settings-voice.test.tsx`: jsdom header, `vi.hoisted` mocks of `./api`, `expo-router`, `react-native`; renders `BotSettingsScreen`. Around line 720 it asserts section order using its `labels` map.
  - `apps/mobile/lib/approvals-settings.test.tsx`: a settings-screen test to mirror.

## Patterns to follow

**Auth session:**
```ts
const { openAuthSessionAsync } = await import("expo-web-browser").catch(() => ({ openAuthSessionAsync: undefined }));
if (!openAuthSessionAsync) { await Linking.openURL(authorizeUrl); return; }
const result = await openAuthSessionAsync(authorizeUrl, "rakazo://code-hosts/gitlab/callback", { preferEphemeralSession: true });
if (result.type !== "success") return;
const callback = new URL(result.url);
if (callback.protocol !== "rakazo:") return;
await rpc("codeHosts/gitlab/oauth/complete", { state: callback.searchParams.get("state") ?? "", code: callback.searchParams.get("code") ?? "" });
```
Also handle the deep link when the app opens from a cold start, through an Expo Router route at `app/code-hosts/gitlab/callback.tsx` that completes the flow and then replaces itself with `/connections`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/mobile/app/(settings)/connections.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - **List.** Rows for each connection showing provider name and label, using native list styling as in the other settings screens. A native context menu or long-press offers "Disconnect", confirmed with `Alert.alert` and a destructive button.
  - **Adding.** A native header "+" menu item (`@expo/ui` menu or native header items) offers "GitHub" and "GitLab". Each opens a native form sheet or pushed screen with:
    - Server URL, prefilled;
    - Token, using `secureTextEntry`;
    - GitLab only: a native switch "Use OAuth app" that swaps Token for Client ID and Client secret;
    - a "Connect" header button.
  - **Errors.** Show scope errors in a native `Alert`.
  - **Secrets.** Clear secret fields after submit.
- **GOTCHA**: never log or persist tokens (no AsyncStorage), and never put them in route params.

### CREATE `apps/mobile/app/code-hosts/gitlab/callback.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: read `state` and `code` with `useLocalSearchParams`, call `complete`, then `router.replace("/connections")`. On failure, show an alert and then replace.

### UPDATE `apps/mobile/app/bot-settings.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: a `SettingsGroup label={t("Repositories")}` placed after Skills, following `BOT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS.advanced`.
  - Load `bots/repositories/list` and `codeHosts/connections/list`.
  - Rows show `fullPath`. A context menu offers "Remove", which calls `set` without that item.
  - The add control is a `MenuPicker`. Its choices are the repositories from every connection, loaded on first open, labelled `fullPath`. When there are more than `MODEL_SEARCH_THRESHOLD` choices, push a new `app/bot-repositories.tsx` list screen with a search field, mirroring `app/bot-model.tsx`.
  - No-computer state: read `sandboxProvider` from `rpc("me")`, which the screen already loads, and render only the one-line message.
  - No connections: a row that links to `/connections`.

### Tests
- `apps/mobile/lib/code-host-connections.test.tsx`, mirroring `approvals-settings.test.tsx` with `./api` mocked:
  - it renders the connections and Disconnect calls `codeHosts/connections/remove`;
  - GitLab token connect sends `{ baseUrl, token }`;
  - the OAuth path calls `start` with `client: "mobile"` and then `complete`, with `expo-web-browser` mocked to return `rakazo://code-hosts/gitlab/callback?state=s&code=c`;
  - a non-`rakazo:` callback is ignored.
- Extend `apps/mobile/lib/bot-settings-voice.test.tsx`, or add `apps/mobile/lib/bot-repositories.test.tsx`:
  - the Repositories group renders after Skills;
  - adding calls `bots/repositories/set` with the full list;
  - with `sandboxProvider: "none"` only the message shows;
  - the existing section-order assertions stay green.
- For native UI CI can't capture, don't use web screenshots. If the change is large, add a flow to the existing iOS screenshot catalog (`pnpm test:mobile-screenshots`). Otherwise skip it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Settings → Connections lists, connects (token, or GitLab OAuth through a native auth session) and disconnects code-host connections, using native controls.
- [ ] Cold-start deep link `rakazo://code-hosts/gitlab/callback?…` completes OAuth.
- [ ] Bot settings has a native "Repositories" group with add and remove, a long-list screen, and the no-computer state.
- [ ] No token or secret is stored, logged, or put in route params.
- [ ] Tests pass: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile test`

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm check
pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile test
pnpm vitest run apps/mobile/lib/code-host-connections.test.tsx apps/mobile/lib/bot-settings-voice.test.tsx
```
